title: Held-out adjudication of deterministic rotation, confined drift, and switching
commit_status: content frozen by file hash; no git commit created because the executor was not authorized to commit
independent_unit: patient, with sessions nested within patient

outer_folds.group: trial within session; linked release views remain in the same fold and only one canonical view enters primary inference
outer_folds.preprocessing: fit FrozenPSTHTransform, dimensionality, coding axes, hyperparameters, and latent transforms on outer-training data only
outer_folds.smoothing: forbidden for drift models; permitted only for rotation sensitivity and visualization

models.M1: M0 plus a trial-shared deterministic operator for coding-axis rotation
models.M2: M0 plus a confined stochastic latent process with separate process and observation noise
models.M4: recurrent switching linear dynamical system with an explicit state-transition model

primary_score: held-out negative log likelihood in nats per observed scalar/bin, averaged within session then patient

minimum_effect.rationale: effects smaller than these thresholds do not materially alter a session-level held-out prediction and are treated as practically tied

winner_rule: A model wins only if its patient-level mean primary-score improvement over every simpler nested alternative exceeds 0.01 nats/observation, its 95% patient-cluster bootstrap interval excludes zero, and it improves at least 60% of estimable patients. Otherwise the models are tied. Non-nested M4 is compared with the same primary threshold and interval rule; complexity is additionally checked by held-out likelihood and BIC.

rotation_test.estimand: held-out cross-temporal-generalization recovery after counter-rotating axes with a training-fit shared operator
rotation_test.positive_rule: patient-level recovery exceeds the stationary-code matched null by at least 0.05 standardized crossnobis units and the 95% patient-cluster interval excludes zero

drift_test.estimand: held-out prediction advantage from a trial's own earlier residual beyond the condition-by-time mean
drift_test.positive_rule: advantage exceeds R2=0.01, the 95% patient-cluster interval excludes zero, and its lag-decay rate interval overlaps the independently fitted lambda interval

joint_outcomes.rotation_only: rotation test positive; drift test negative
joint_outcomes.drift_only: drift test positive; rotation test negative
joint_outcomes.switching: M4 satisfies the non-nested winner rule against M2 and M3

nonestimable_policy: Record non-convergence, failed identifiability, missing behavior, and insufficient independent units as explicit nonestimable outcomes; never encode them as zero effects.

confirmatory_family: lambda parallel versus permuted-axis matched null
multiplicity.correction: Holm within the six-test confirmatory family; all other contrasts exploratory
